Review Netlify?

Reviewers describe Netlify as a simple, reliable way to deploy and manage sites, especially static projects. The most repeated praise is fast setup, easy GitHub-based CI/CD, and not having to think much about hosting after launch; users also call out domains, SSL, and smooth updates. Founder feedback from the makers of Dover, Replay, and Eddie AI echoes that it works well for hosting, builds, and quick deployment. Negative feedback is largely absent.

My experience with Netlify has been highly positive. The platform provides an incredibly simple and fast process for deploying websites, especially static ones. Integration with version control systems like GitHub streamlines deployment automation, and the CI/CD functionality makes managing updates easy. I particularly appreciate the built-in capabilities for configuring domains and SSL certificates. Thanks to Netlify, I've been able to focus more on development without spending a lot of time on infrastructure
